Analysed 1,000+ employee engagement survey responses using Python (Pandas, NumPy) and built multiple linear regression models with VIF-based feature reduction.

title: Yang Lu
text:
Academic Projects


Malaysia Food Tourism — NLP & Sentiment Analytics

Processed 200K food tourism reviews using Python NLP pipelines.
Performed text cleaning, tokenisation, POS tagging, lemmatisation, and exploratory analysis.
Built an LDA topic model with coherence score optimisation and inter-topic distance visualisation.
Applied sentiment analysis using VADER, Naïve Bayes, and Logistic Regression.
Developed a Priority Score framework to identify strategic improvement areas for Malaysia’s F&B ecosystem.



Agricultural Yield Prediction for Bangladesh

Analysed 4,600+ crop–district observations to identify drivers of bumper harvests.
Engineered climate stability features and research-based climatic indexes.
Built and compared models in SAS Viya including Logistic Regression, Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, and SVM.
Evaluated performance using F1-score, precision, recall, and AUC.



Visual Analytics — VAST Challenge 2025
Project Dashboard: https://covertreef.netlify.app

Conducted EDA and IDEA using R (tidyverse, ggplot2) to analyse temporal communication patterns.
Applied network analysis (visNetwork, ggraph) to identify influence pathways and hidden relationships.
Built an interactive Shiny dashboard deployed via Netlify for investigative storytelling.
Integrated temporal, network, and topic-based signals to assess suspicious behaviour.



Operational Data Modeling

Designed a relational data model for a manufacturing and after-sales service environment by translating detailed business rules into a complete Entity-Relationship (ER) diagram, defining entities, attributes, cardinalities, and data integrity constraints.
Implemented the full MySQL database using DDL by building tables, setting primary and foreign keys, defining composite keys, structuring relationships, and loading sample datasets for analysis.
Developed analytical SQL queries to support key business insights such as monthly sales patterns, equipment condition classification, cost tracking, part-usage trends, and employee performance metrics.
Applied advanced SQL techniques including multi-table joins, nested and correlated subqueries, CASE expressions, aggregation logic (SUM, COUNT, AVG), HAVING filters, date-time functions, string operations, and conditional logic such as IF and IFNULL.
Created stored procedures and triggers to automate business-rule validation, enforce data consistency, and generate dynamic reports driven by user-defined input parameters.
Strengthened technical skills in relational schema design, SQL optimisation, data quality control, and building database solutions that support end-to-end operations in a manufacturing-style service and maintenance workflow.



Pricing Strategy & Financial Modelling for Retail Business

Built end-to-end spreadsheet-based decision models to evaluate pricing, demand elasticity, customer behaviors, and profitability in a competitive market.
Developed customer management and loyalty models to assess shifts between health-conscious and indulgent consumer segments and forecast revenue impact.
Conducted price elasticity analysis across product categories, identifying inelastic pricing opportunities and high-sensitivity segments.
Performed scenario simulation and sensitivity analysis using Monte Carlo techniques (RAND, NORM.INV) to forecast demand, revenue, and gross profit.
Designed break-even pricing models using Solver to optimise pricing decisions under cost and demand constraints.
Analysed competitor pricing, promotions, and market positioning to inform strategic pricing recommendations.
Built P&L forecasting and gross margin analysis models using historical financial statements to assess long-term profitability under cost inflation.
